findings.claim: The retired `fhir-knowledge-curator` name remains outside the docs redirect note, violating the required grep result.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1.2 requires `grep -rn 'fhir-ideation-strategist\|fhir-knowledge-curator'` outside the allowed archive/prometheus paths to return only the redirect note, but `.kbd-orchestrator/project.json:67` contains `no role assigned since fhir-knowledge-curator merged into fhir-tech-lead`.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the retired agent name from `.kbd-orchestrator/project.json` or reword it without the retired identifier.

findings.claim: The docs contain multiple retired-agent references beyond the single redirect note required by the acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1.2 says the grep should return only the redirect note, but `docs/agent-team.md` includes additional mentions at lines 21-22 (`fhir-ideation-strategist` and `fhir-knowledge-curator` merge bullets) and lines 68 and 77 (`formerly ...`) outside the `## Retired agents` redirect note.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the retired names only in the `## Retired agents` redirect note and reword the roster/matrix entries to refer to `fhir-architect` and `fhir-tech-lead` duties without naming retired agents.
